owls.screen.title: Ordinary Wizarding Levels
owls.screen.confirm_text: You are about to sit your Ordinary Wizarding Levels. This examination cannot be retaken. Are you prepared?
owls.confirm.profession_body: Choose %s as your profession? This choice is permanent.
profession.auror.description: Elite Dark wizard catchers employed by the Ministry of Magic.
profession.healer.description: Magical medical practitioners of St. Mungo's Hospital.
profession.wandmaker.description: Craftspeople of the ancient art of wand-making.
profession.magizoologist.description: Scholars and carers of magical creatures.
profession.curse_breaker.description: Gringotts specialists who neutralise ancient magical traps.
profession.potioneer.description: Masters of the subtle science and exact art of potion-making.
profession.hit_wizard.description: Ministry enforcement specialists for dangerous magical threats.
profession.obliviator.description: Ministry operatives specialising in Memory Charms.
profession.unspeakable.description: Researchers of the deepest mysteries in the Department of Mysteries.
profession.professor.description: Teachers of magical subjects at Hogwarts School.
profession.quidditch_player.description: Professional players of the Wizarding World's most beloved sport.
profession.journalist.description: Reporters and writers for the Daily Prophet and beyond.
profession.arithmancer.description: Practitioners of magical numerical prediction and calculation.
profession.herbologist.description: Expert cultivators and researchers of magical plants.
item.wizards_and_beasts.wand_blank.toolt: Wood: not attuned — use on a log or stem to set the wood type
wandcraft.resonance.matched: The wand has chosen you. %s wood, %s core.
wandcraft.resonance.mismatch: This wand does not suit you. It resists your magic.
wandcraft.resonance.notYourWand: This wand's true master is another. It will not serve you fully.
wandcraft.cast.requires_bond: This wand has not chosen you yet — bond with it before casting.
wandcraft.cast.wrong_master: This wand answers to another witch or wizard — it will not cast for you.
wandcraft.allegiance.transferred: The wand's allegiance has shifted to you.
wandcraft.allegiance.lost: Your wand no longer recognises you as its master.
wandcraft.allegiance.resisted: The wand resisted the transfer. It remains loyal.
wandcraft.allegiance.stolen_warning: You hold another's wand. It will not perform at its best.
wandcraft.corruption.threshold_warning: Your wand darkens. It hungers for darker magic.
wandcraft.corruption.fully_corrupted: Your wand has fully embraced the Dark Arts.
item.wizards_and_beasts.soul_drained.des: Your soul has been consumed by a Dementor.
spell.wizards_and_beasts.finite_incantat: Cancels ongoing magical effects on the target. Cannot counter Unforgivable curses or creature-sourced effects.
spell.wizards_and_beasts.colloportus.des: Magically seals a door, gate, or trapdoor so Alohomora cannot open it until the seal is cleared.
spell.wizards_and_beasts.liberacorpus.de: Counter to levitation jinxes — ends Levicorpus-style floating on the target.
spell.wizards_and_beasts.riddikulus.desc: Forces a Boggart to assume a humorous shape. (Cosmetic burst until Boggarts exist.)

gamps_law.wizards_and_beasts.food_conjur: Gamp's Law forbids conjuring food from nothing. Magic can only duplicate what already exists.
gamps_law.wizards_and_beasts.currency_co: The goblins of Gringotts have long ensured that wizarding coin cannot be conjured. This spell yields only worthless imitation.
gamps_law.wizards_and_beasts.life_creati: To create life is beyond the reach of magic. Even the darkest wizard cannot overrule this law.
gamps_law.wizards_and_beasts.love_conjur: Love cannot be conjured. What this magic can imitate is obsession, and obsession is not love.
gamps_law.wizards_and_beasts.information: Magic cannot conjure knowledge that has no source in the world.
item.wizards_and_beasts.conjured_spoiled: This food was conjured against Gamp's Law. It is inedible and will spoil if not disposed of.
item.wizards_and_beasts.counterfeit_gall: A counterfeit Galleon. Gringotts enchantments render this coin worthless - it will be refused by any legitimate vendor.
item.wizards_and_beasts.broom_polish.too: A magical broom-care compound. Apply regularly for best performance.
item.wizards_and_beasts.enchanted_twig_b: Individually hand-selected twigs, bound with gold-alloy thread. Used in elite broom maintenance.
broom_lore.wizards_and_beasts.cleansweep: An old school-issue broom. Reliable, if unremarkable.
A trusted broom for those who fly often.
broom_lore.wizards_and_beasts.nimbus_200: The fastest broom of its year.
Once the pride of Gryffindor's Quidditch team.
Purchased for the entire Slytherin team by Lucius Malfoy.
Slightly superior to the 2000, though not without controversy.
broom_lore.wizards_and_beasts.firebolt.1: Internationally used at the 1994 Quidditch World Cup.
broom_lore.wizards_and_beasts.firebolt.2: Anti-jinx enchantments are proprietary and unreplicable.
broom_lore.wizards_and_beasts.firebolt_s: The official mount of the British and Irish national Quidditch team.
broom_lore.wizards_and_beasts.oakshaft_7: First broom to cross the Atlantic.
Virtually indestructible. Predates the Cushioning Charm.
item.wizards_and_beasts.deluminator.boun: The Deluminator is now attuned to %s.
item.wizards_and_beasts.deluminator.retu: The Deluminator gathers its guiding light...
No guiding bond answers the Deluminator.
A guiding light leads you to %s.
item.wizards_and_beasts.trunk_access_mod: Sealed to the owner. None may enter uninvited.
Entry granted to those holding a Sympathetic Key.
Unguarded. Any witch or wizard may enter.
item.wizards_and_beasts.portkey.unlinked: Sneak-right-click a block to bind this Portkey.
